data.one_liner: Connect to Sunmi printers, print text, barcodes, QR codes, images, and control cash drawers.
data.what_it_does: Supports interacting with Sunmi Android devices to print text, custom styles, barcodes, QR codes, and images. It also provides control over the cash drawer, LCD screen functions, and device status checks.
use_when: Building an Android application specifically targeted at Sunmi POS hardware
You need to print receipts, barcodes, and QR codes using built-in Sunmi printers
avoid_when: Targeting iOS, web, or desktop platforms (Android only)
Using non-Sunmi thermal printers without ESC/POS compatibility wrappers
strengths: Comprehensive coverage of Sunmi inner printer features
Supports LCD display functions and cash drawer management
weaknesses: Label printer features still lack extensive testing devices
data.setup_notes: Works only on Android. Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and use on supported Sunmi hardware.
